# Projects KIT Scenarist saved

Each `.kitsp` here was written by Lexington from the Fountain beside it
(`lexington-check.fountain`, `proverka.ru.fountain`, `bdika.he.fountain`,
`jiancha.zh.fountain`, and `layla.hekaya`, Lexington's own Hekaya test
script), then opened and saved in KIT Scenarist 0.7.2 rc15 on 2026-11-28.
The scripts are Lexington's. The user name KIT records in its history
tables was replaced with `writer` (and the database vacuumed); nothing else
was changed.

They were written by Lexington 1.67.2's rules, before 1.67.3: in
`proverka.ru` the last line, СМЕНА КАДРА:, is action, as Russian then had no
transitions; in `jiancha.zh` the full-width （轻声） is dialogue.
